subject: JOB (NYC): Research Assistant, Modeling and Analytics

messages.subject: JOB (NYC): Research Assistant, Modeling and Analytics
parts:
Hi all! My organization, EcoHealth Alliance, is hiring a research assistant for our modeling and analytics team to do statistical analysis, visualization, and data management and curation. We're an NGO based in NYC working at the intersection of health and conservation. You'd be working with me and the rest of the modeling team on a mix of research projects projects and helping implement reproducible research practices in the organization.

All backgrounds may apply, but we're targeting people with an M.S. in statistics, ecology, epidemiology, or public health, some R-savviness and exposure and interest in reproducible research and data science.

EcoHealth is a great place to work with a great group of interdisciplinary scientists and developers on applied public health and environmental research.  We also have a history of helping employees earn Masters' and Ph.D. degrees while working with us. 

More details here: https://dl.dropbox.com/s/1mgh79sef4wqe5q/Research%20Assistant%202016%20Job%20Advert.pdf .  I'm happy to chat with anyone about the gig and the organization.

As I'm not up on what the data sciency groups on campus are these days, please forward this to any that would be interested.

Thanks!

Noam
